narrative.headline: An even afternoon: daylight and a real meal offset the screens, but the coffee ran late.
paragraphs: Between 3:26 and 4:09 PM the glasses saw 28 minutes of sustained screen time in nine blocks, broken up by about 10 minutes outdoors. The rice bowl counts toward the Mediterranean pattern, worth +0.3 h. Net for the day is 0.0 h: nothing earned yet, nothing lost.

The cost is people. No conversation was seen today, and social connection is the largest single factor on the board at −1.1 h. Coffee was in frame seven times, the last at 4:06 PM, late enough to cut into deep sleep tonight. Alcohol was in frame too; one drink scores −0.03 h.
suggestions: No more caffeine today. Water or herbal tea from here.
See or call one person before dinner, even for ten minutes.
Walk outside for 15 minutes before the light goes.
narrative.spoken: Even afternoon. Daylight and the rice bowl offset the screens. No more coffee today, and talk to someone before dinner.
